caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object resembling a trident with additional features, rendered in shades of black and grey on a beige background. The central component consists of a vertical handle with a rounded top and a small circular hole near the end, which extends downward to connect to a horizontal crossbar. From each end of the crossbar, a short, curved hook projects outward and upward in opposite directions. Additionally, four long, tapering prongs extend downward from the crossbar, evenly spaced and pointed at the ends. At the bottom left, a small ruler marked "INCHES" provides scale, and at the bottom right, the name "FRANCIS BORELLI" is written. The overall composition is centered, detailed with shading to convey a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Skewers and Holder
